hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook that routes all token flows through Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes via a configurable bonding curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully override Uniswap v4's native AMM logic. Standard liquidity positions and donations are blocked.
